thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Datadog: Elevated 5xx rate on elb/redwood-hosted-api-prod (us-east-1) — 12m spike, 18% error rate over baseline
Maeve (oncall): seeing 502/504 across multiple customers in us-east-1 — paging SRE
Samir (infra): pulling ELB metrics now. Give me logs for one request id if you have it
Jordan (support): got inbound tickets from Acme & Boxly reporting timeouts + 502s, starting collecting examples
Ivy (sre): @Samir can you check target-group health and any recent deploys?
Samir (infra): no deploys in last hour. Target groups show healthy_count oscillating, some AZs with 0 healthy targets in us-east-1a
Maeve (oncall): confirmed. ELB metrics show backend_connection_errors increasing, and some targets in us-east-1a are flapping UNHEALTHY -> INITIALIZING
Liam (prod-eng): could this be kernel/conntrack on the hosts? Similar symptoms earlier in other regions
Samir (infra): running quick host health queries...
Samir (infra): ```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:1234567890:targetgroup/redwood-prod-tg/abcdef
# results: ~30% targets: unhealthy (Timeout / ConnectionReset)
```
Ivy (sre): route53 lookups show some cached records still pointing to old ELB IPs? TTLs were 300s but we're seeing long propagation for some ISPs
Maeve (oncall): customer impact: 15% of requests across hosted-api are failing in us-east-1; we've paused canary traffic but prod still affected. SLAs at risk for several high-traffic customers
Eleni (customer-success): flagged top 5 customers to their CSMs and opened a bridge for Acme. They're asking for ETA and mitigation steps
Jordan (support): shared sample request ids: req-3f5a, req-7d2b — errors show backend connection timeout from ELB to instance
Liam (prod-eng): action plan: 1) remove problematic AZ from ELB routing (weighted shift) 2) increase route53 failover weight to us-west-2 3) drain/unregister unhealthy targets and cycle instances in us-east-1a 4) maintain customer comms
Ivy (sre): I'm +1 for weighted DNS shift. Doing controlled shift of 30% -> us-west-2 for next 10m then reassess. Lowering Route53 TTL temporarily to 60s
Samir (infra): performing ELB AZ drain for us-east-1a now: ```
aws elbv2 set-subnets --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:1234567890:loadbalancer/app/redwood-hosted-api/aaaaaa --subnets subnet-keep-1a subnet-keep-1b
# removed subnet mapping to 1a
```
Maeve (oncall): initiated traffic shift + updating runbook note 2.3 with manual steps taken. Notifying customers in bridge
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4598765432 — mountain: Regional ELB health flapping (us-east-1). Severity: SEV2. Bridge: https://redwood.zoom/bridge/INC-4598765432
Eleni (customer-success): posted to Acme CSM: "We are routing ~30% of traffic to us-west-2 to reduce errors; we'll provide 15min updates." They replied :thumbsup: but want ETA for full recovery
Samir (infra): cycling instances in problematic ASGs (rolling restart w/ health-check wait): ```
for id in $(aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --region us-east-1 --query 'AutoScalingGroups[?contains(Tags[*].Value, `hosted-api`)].Instances[*].InstanceId' --output text); do aws ec2 reboot-instances --instance-ids $id; sleep 20; done
```
Ivy (sre): confirmed route53 weight shift applied; observed 20% drop in 5xx within 4m. still seeing elevated latencies for some legacy customers behind certain ISPs
Jordan (support): updating support tickets: "We're mitigating by shifting traffic and cycling hosts; degradation persists for ~15% of requests in us-east-1. Next update in 15m."
Maeve (oncall): starting post-incident logs dump for forensic: collect ELB access logs + instance syslogs from window 10:00-10:30 UTC
Liam (prod-eng): investigating kernel/netstack metrics on affected AMIs — pushing instrumentation patch to staging to verify conntrack table pressure hypothesis
Samir (infra): manual remediation: removed 1a from rotation, cycled hosts, route53 shift. Monitoring for 10m. If 5xx stays >5% we'll failover more aggressively to us-west-2
Ivy (sre): we saw a steady recovery in us-east-1b/c after cycling — us-east-1a remains suspicious, planning host replacements there
Eleni (customer-success): live note sent to enterprise customers and status page updated: "Partial service degradation in us-east-1; mitigation in progress; cross-region routing in effect."
Maeve (oncall): preparing handoff to night crew in 25m. @Ivy you'll take handoff if issues persist; leave timeline and actions in incident doc
Ivy (sre): I'll take it. Adding checklist: verify Route53 weight, confirm ELB target health, validate no recent deployment, escalate to AWS if host flapping continues
incident-bot: Reminder: Pager rotation — next oncall: Ivy (sre). Scheduled handoff at 4598765700
Jordan (support): final note before short break: customers on older SDKs may see cached DNS entries longer — advising CSMs to suggest restart/retry.
Maeve (oncall): closing bridge for now — moving to monitoring phase. Will reopen if error rate climbs above threshold. Handoff complete at 4598765740
Ivy (sre): acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on the bridge and escalate to AWS support with packet captures if we see host-level conn resets persist
Liam (prod-eng): follow-up actions captured: AMI kernel update, automated ASG replace policy tweak, add Route53 failover playbook to runbook
